# Synthetic profiling input

`history-2pages.pdf` is the 2,530-byte deterministic ReportLab fixture generated by
`tests/profile_document_history.py` (two pages, forty ASCII text rows each,
`Canvas(..., invariant=1, pageCompression=1)`). It contains only synthetic test
text, no user data. Its actual extracted content is 6,810 bytes with source labels.
The integrated profile uses it to seed eight historical attachment messages.

SHA-256 is recorded by each profile invocation; the source generator is the
reproduction authority. This is text extraction, not OCR or rendered document
understanding.
